configurePresets.name: macos-arm64-ship
configurePresets.displayName: macOS arm64 — native SHIPPING app (no Node, no Python, offline)
configurePresets.description: The application half of the shipping build. Links the forge_kernel_core built by forge-kernel's macos-arm64-ship preset (same binaryDir convention, so the two presets find each other with no flags). Python3 lookup is DISABLED so the build runs no interpreter: the one Python step in this project, the op-constraint table drift check (forge_ui_op_table_check), is a source-consistency check that forge-desktop/test/native_ship_gate.sh runs as release tooling instead, and ui/test/run_op_constraint_gate.sh stays its gate of record. First-party targets keep -Wall -Wextra -Werror from CMakeLists.txt; the gate audits that through the exported compile commands.

buildPresets.name: macos-arm64-ship
buildPresets.description: What the bundle carries (forge_desktop, forge_kernel_worker, forge_update, libforge_expr) plus the headless gates the shipped code must pass before it is packaged. native_ship_gate.sh reads the forge_desktop_*_gate names from THIS list and runs exactly those, so the list lives in one place.
